scripts.clean:ports: for port in 3000 3001 3002 4001; do lsof -ti :$port | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; echo 'Ports cleaned'
scripts.dev: bun run clean:ports && turbo run dev --parallel --filter=@autix/chat --filter=@autix/chat-web
scripts.dev:langchain: bun run clean:ports && turbo run dev --parallel --filter=@autix/api --filter=@autix/web
